namespace PubAC09
def deg (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | (a, b) :: es => (if a == v then 1 else 0) + (if b == v then 1 else 0) + deg v es
def edgeEndpointCount : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: es => 2 + edgeEndpointCount es
theorem handshaking_degSum (es : List (Nat × Nat)) : edgeEndpointCount es = 2 * es.length := by sorry
theorem deg_append (v : Nat) (es1 es2 : List (Nat × Nat)) : deg v (es1 ++ es2) = deg v es1 + deg v es2 := by sorry
end PubAC09
